title: Import-reconciliation activation: apply the state-path redirection check before writing and the post-commit integrity check after
outcome: activate_engram_import_reconciliation_sqlite rejects a redirected state path before its transaction and verifies commit integrity after commit, before the read-back and the effect, like every other metadata writer; a failure is treated as a failed acknowledgement.
acceptance: Import-reconciliation activation: apply the state-path redirection check before writing and the post-commit integrity check after is done
